Su resistencia de radiación es de unos 7: Its radiation resistance is about 73 Ω and its directivity 1.64 (2.15 dBi). The radiation pattern is proportional to [cos(π/2·cos θ)/sin θ]², with its maximum perpendicular to the wire and a null along its axis.
¿Cómo se calcula la potencia radiada?: How is the radiated power calculated?
P_rad = ½·I₀²·R_rad. Un dipolo de media: P_rad = ½·I₀²·R_rad. A half-wave dipole with I₀ = 1 A radiates ½ · 1² · 73 ≈ 36.5 W. For a short (Hertzian) dipole, R_rad = 80π²(l/λ)².
